# fall-euaiact-sdk

> EU AI Act toolkit as a JavaScript library: the gated risk classifier the fall-euaiact page runs, obligations and dates after Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, an Article 12 audit log, Annex IV documents and Article 50 badges, Ed25519 signing. MIT.

Live page: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-euaiact-sdk/
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/fall-euaiact-sdk
Install: npm install github:sjgant80-hub/fall-euaiact-sdk
Product page: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-euaiact/

## Exports

- classifyText(text) · classify(text): The risk tier with articles, triggers and confidence. classifyText never throws; classify keeps the older result shape and rejects an empty description.
- obligationsFor(tier) · deadlineFor(tier): What the tier requires and the date it applies from.
- assess(text, { at }) · verifyAssessment(a): Seal a verdict; check a sealed verdict was not altered.
- deepClassify(text, { provider, apiKey, model }): A second opinion from a model you choose (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), with your own key. The Anthropic default is claude-opus-5-5.
- ARTICLES · DEADLINES · PENALTIES · ANNEX_III_CATEGORIES · searchArticles · getArticle · articlesForTier: The article navigator.
- createAuditShim({ sink, dbName }): An Article 12 event log: log, exportAll, verifyChain, clear.
- createAnnexIV(values) · generateAnnexIV · validateValues · DOC_FIELDS: Annex IV technical documentation: Markdown, HTML or JSON, in six languages, and signable.
- createTransparencyBadge({ category, language, … }): An accessible Article 50 disclosure, with an impression log and a signed configuration.
- generateKeypair · sign · verify: Ed25519 with the platform's WebCrypto; accepts 32-byte seeds and libsodium's 64-byte keys.

## Limits

- The classifier matches phrases. A system described in unusual words can be missed; the November 2026 repair widened two Article 5 rules (emotion recognition at work or in education, live facial recognition by police in public) after both were found slipping through.
- Real-time remote biometric identification by police in public is classified prohibited; retrospective identification is high-risk instead, and the verdict says so.
- deepClassify's OpenAI and Google default models are older and may be retired: pass model for those providers.
- Annex IV output is a starting draft; the badge text meets Article 50's aim but you decide where and when it is shown.
